text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yawn… I'm so sleepy… and my body feels so heavy…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Maybe this has to do with yesterday's race. But the other runners look just fine…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh right… Is this because I'm not race-ready yet?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: In… in that case, I'll have a really big lunch, and train lots and lots!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Now, what to eat today… Everything… Yawn… looks so delicious…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, I forgot to grab… a tray… Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-whoaaaa?! Wait, d-did I fall asleep standing up?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Aaagh! What happened to my food?! No way… I must have knocked it over with my hand!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh deary me, what a disaster! Does anyone have any injuries? Did you stain your uniform?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm soooo soooorry! I d-d-dropped all my food!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: That's perfectly all right. I can always make more. Hurry and go get a new tray before your lunch break ends!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuugh… How could I do such a thing? I'm so slow, wimpy, and clumsy, and now I've made it everyone's problem…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Urk… Waaaaah! I'm a big, big, dummmy!
